title: Data Governance Manager
description:
Data Governance Manager - London / Birmingham (Flexible hybrid working) | Full-Time / Permanent  

Up to £70k (depending on experience) + bonus and excellent benefits including healthcare, wellbeing support, 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, life insurance and more. 

We're looking for an experienced Data Governance Manager to help embed and drive data governance across Compass Group UK & Ireland - a global leader in food services. Working within our Enterprise Data team, you'll play a key role in establishing governance frameworks, ownership models and data standards that enable trusted, high-quality data across the business.  

This is an exciting opportunity to influence how data is governed at scale while supporting our AI-first strategy and ensuring governance becomes a practical enabler of business success. 

Compass Digital & Technology is where ideas turn into possibilities.  

We’re the technology team behind Compass Group UK&I, part of Compass Group, one of the world’s largest hospitality businesses. We’re shaping the next generation of products, platforms and experiences for Compass Group, harnessing AI to create competitive advantage and accelerate growth. 

We create, manage and deploy technology which supports our operators, clients and guests. From enterprise-scale cloud engineering, cybersecurity, mobile ordering and guest-facing experiences to everyday IT support. Our work reaches across our business and all walks of life, from schools to banks and into the daily lives of millions of people.  

But D&T is about more than technology. It’s a place to be curious, challenge what’s possible and turn great ideas into real outcomes. A place where talented people collaborate, experiment, learn and make an impact at scale.  

We own it from idea to outcome. We challenge what’s possible. And together, we’re creating better solutions, every day. 

Data Governance Manager – The role 

  • Support the implementation and adoption of enterprise data governance frameworks across multiple business domains. 
  • Establish and maintain governance arrangements, ensuring clear ownership, stewardship and accountability for data assets. 
  • Develop and maintain business glossaries, agreed definitions and governance records to support consistency across the organisation. 
  • Facilitate governance forums, maintain decision logs, track actions and support effective escalation processes. 
  • Coordinate governance controls and assurance activities, working closely with Privacy, Legal and policy specialists. 
  • Engage stakeholders across operational and central functions to embed governance practices into day-to-day business activities. 
  • Partner with Data Quality, Product and Business teams to address governance challenges, clarify ownership and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Monitor governance adoption, identify barriers to compliance and ensure agreed decisions are translated into practical actions. 
  • Promote a culture of accountability, transparency and trusted data management across the organisation. 

What we're looking for 

  • Experience establishing and implementing data governance frameworks, stewardship models and business glossaries across multiple functions.
  • Strong understanding of data ownership, stewardship, governance controls and decision-making processes. 
  • Excellent facilitation, stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence a wide range of audiences.
  • Experience maintaining governance records, business definitions and decision documentation.
  • Ability to resolve ambiguity, navigate competing priorities and facilitate consensus across stakeholders. 
  • Working knowledge of data protection principles, governance controls and assurance activities. 
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to track actions through to successful adoption and measurable outcomes. 
  • Passion for improving data quality, governance maturity and business confidence in data.

What you'll get in return 

  • Competitive salary with bonus and full company benefits
  • 27 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a holiday purchase scheme
  • Healthcare & wellbeing: Aviva Digicare, Medicash (dental, optical, therapy treatments)
  • Mental health support: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
  • Family benefits: Enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption leave. 2 days' additional leave after returning from maternity leave, day off for your baby's first birthday, enhanced family leave
  • Perks & discounts: Shopping, entertainment, and travel discounts, 20% off Nuffield Health and 10% off PureGym memberships
  • Financial wellbeing: Pension scheme, Life Assurance, preferred rates on salary finance products
  • Development opportunities: Professional subscriptions, ongoing training and structured career pathways

Compass Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
